## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what's missing or awkward today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like Proxion to do instead.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about (including "do nothing" and deep-linking to the stock PVE UI).

## Phase

Which phase does this belong to? (see the README's roadmap)

- [ ] Phase 1 -- read-only
- [ ] Phase 2 -- actions (start/stop/migrate/snapshot, ...)
- [ ] Phase 3 -- extras (console thumbnails, built-in SSH, alarms, storage browser, ...)
- [ ] Not sure

## Additional context

Anything else -- mockups, links to the equivalent PVE or vSphere UI, etc.
